items.desc: King James text tagged with Strong's numbers — tap a word for the lexicon.

items.name: Ahirani New Testament
items.desc: An example of a non-English module (open.bible USFM).

items.name: Strong's Greek & Hebrew Dictionary
items.desc: 14,197 full lexical entries (definition + etymology + KJV usage). Every Strong's number in the reader opens a complete definition.

items.name: Abbott-Smith Greek Lexicon
items.desc: 10,847 New-Testament Greek entries (Abbott-Smith), keyed to Strong's numbers — tap any Greek word in the reader for its definition.

items.name: Brown–Driver–Briggs Hebrew Lexicon
items.desc: 8,181 Hebrew & Aramaic entries from Brown–Driver–Briggs, keyed to Strong's numbers — tap any Hebrew word in the reader for its definition.

items.name: Word Definitions (WordNet)
items.desc: Plain-English meanings for the words in the Bible you read, on any translation. Tap a verse, then Define. Downloads the first time you use it.

items.name: Word Definitions (Webster 1913)
items.desc: Older, richer meanings from Webster’s 1913 dictionary — closer to the language of the KJV. When installed, Define uses it first and falls back to WordNet.

items.name: Greek New Testament (original words)
items.desc: The Greek text of the New Testament, word by word, with each word's transliteration, Strong's number and grammar (STEPBible TAGNT). Download only if you want the original language.

items.name: Hebrew Old Testament (original words)
items.desc: The Hebrew text of the Old Testament, word by word, with each word's transliteration, Strong's number and grammar (STEPBible TAHOT). Download only if you want the original language.

items.name: Import a dictionary…
items.desc: Add your own MySword .dct.mybible dictionary or lexicon.

items.desc: Whole-Bible verse-by-verse commentary.

items.desc: Whole-Bible verse-by-verse commentary.

items.desc: Where scripture echoes scripture — 29,320 verses linked, best-voted first, from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge.

items.name: Geneva Notes 1599 cross-references
items.license: Public Domain · cross-references drawn from the marginal notes of the 1599 Geneva Bible (Ikram Hawramani modern-spelling ebook)
items.desc: Where the Geneva Bible's own margins send the reader — 1,874 verses cross-linked from the 1599 notes.

items.name: Nave's Topical Bible
items.license: Public Domain — Orville J. Nave, 1903 (data via j86schroeder/topical-bible-search, MIT)
items.desc: Cross-references by topic — verses that share a subject in Nave's classic 1903 topical index. 22,455 verses linked across thousands of topics.

items.name: Commentary cross-references
items.license: Extracted from public-domain commentary text (JFB, Matthew Henry, Adam Clarke, Geneva Notes)
items.desc: Cross-references drawn from the text of four public-domain commentaries — 15,649 verses linked from the scripture references those authors cite.

items.name: Douay-Rheims Marginal References
items.license: Unlicense (public domain) — marginal cross-references of the 1609/1582 Douay-Rheims Bible
items.desc: The marginal cross-references printed in the 1609/1582 Douay-Rheims Bible — 1,643 verses linked from an older Catholic tradition.
